verdict.rationale: Attio ships people and companies as default objects (docs-14) and links objects through a graph data model (docs-9, docs-66). Its marketing claims 'instant visibility into the full history of every interaction' (docs-16), with calls automatically logged (docs-23), which covers the core of linked contact/company records with an interaction history. missing for 10: first-party docs describing the per-record activity timeline (which activity types appear, e.g. emails, calls, notes), explicit documentation of the people-to-company relationship, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
